name: STICKEE | Bubba Kush | 1G | Live Resin Disposable
description: Meet Bubba Kush: The Strain That Tucks You In. Bubba Kush: the heavyweight champ of chill, the strain that shows up with a weighted blanket and says, “Don’t worry, I got you.” Born from OG Kush and a mysterious Northern Lights cut, Bubba Kush is pure indica comfort food. Every puff serves up earthy notes of coffee, cocoa, and spice that taste like dessert at grandma’s house. This isn’t your “get stuff done” vape. This is your cancel-your-plans, order-two-pizzas, pass-out-during-the-opening-credits vape. The high hits low and slow, wrapping you in body-melting calm that makes couches feel magnetic.
